text: The Start Network Disaster Risk Financing (DRF) System in Pakistan is a multi-hazard initiative designed to address climate-related risks such as droughts, floods, and heatwaves. It combines risk modeling, anticipatory planning, and pre-arranged finance to enable proactive humanitarian action. Developed in collaboration with national authorities and technical partners, the system uses pre-agreed triggers to release funds before impacts escalate, aiming to protect vulnerable communities more effectively than traditional response models.
